text.font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

svg.text: The panda 100 Hz safety task stops or is starved (defect, interrupt
storm, peripheral lock-up), so the RX timeout, heartbeat and
TX-arrival checks are not run and no siren is raised. A stopped tas…

text.font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

svg.text: Actuation frames reach the panda faster than nominal (a backlog
forwarded back-to-back, or a burst): each frame is within the limits,
but the limits apply per frame, not per time. The reference build…

text.font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

svg.text: An approved frame is altered after the TX check: in the copy into
FDCAN message RAM, the message RAM, the FDCAN core or the
transceiver. The packet XOR catches a change in the software…

text.font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

svg.text: A corrupted SoC-to-MCU SPI transfer passes the 8-bit XOR, so a
wrong CAN frame or a wrong control command (safety mode,
parameter) is taken. The TX limits still apply to frames; nothing…

text.font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

svg.text: Safety state in panda SRAM (controls_allowed, limits, counters)
corrupted: a soft error or permanent fault with no ECC handling
(TSR-503, TSR-507; GAP-08), or a wrong-address write by the SPI…

text.font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

svg.text: The panda time base fails or drifts (HSE crystal, PLL). A lost HSE
is caught by the clock security system, which resets the MCU
(clock.h:118-119); a drift is not detected, so every timeout and rat…

text.font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

svg.text: The panda MCU runs in the brown-out zone during a supply dip
(BOR level not set, PVD not enabled); the supply voltage is only
